newsitem.title: CHINA: China snowstorms kill 15 herders, more missing.
newsitem.headline: China snowstorms kill 15 herders, more missing.

text.p: Fierce snowstorms have killed 15 herders in China's westernmost Xinjiang region and 26 were still missing, the Farmers Daily said on Thursday.

Storms that blanketed parts of the region up to 2.4 metres (yards) deep in snow over the New Year period had killed more than 10,000 head of livestock and caused serious economic losses to herders, the newspaper said.
Officials said on Wednesday recent snowfalls in the area were the worst in 30 years and had stranded nearly 1,000 gold miners, snapped telephone lines and cut off mountain villages.

Helicopters have been used to bring in relief supplies and hunt for the missing since the snowstorms began nearly two weeks ago, they said. Officials had allocated more than 25 million yuan ($3 million) for disaster relief.
Many residents of the sparsely populated region are nomads who raise cattle, goats or sheep for a living.
